name: Lilia-Lette Noxheim
original_name: リリア＝レット・ノクスヘイム
source:
Lilia is the Second Imperial Princess of the Noxheim Empire. She is Irena's younger half-sister by a different mother.

Gentle and mild-mannered, she is somewhat shy. She is not very athletic, but makes up for it by reading extensively and possessing exceptional knowledge.

She admires Irena and always strives help her.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.escude.co.jp/product/imperium/chara05.html]official website[/url]]
